gap: The promise's guarantee ("a stale discovery file can never point at a dead port") only holds within a single boot: a THIS-boot failure correctly skips the write. But if boot N succeeded and wrote mcp-endpoint.json for port P, then the app is relaunched as boot N+1 and that boot's sidecar fails to come up (or times out) before port P is freed/reused, the file from boot N is never deleted or overwritten — an external MCP client reading it discovers a stale, potentially dead port. Smallest fix: delete the discovery file at the start of `start_main_sidecar` (or in the port==0/timeout branches) before attempting the new boot.
